jobs.description_html:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Wir haben ambitionierte Ziele.

Werde ein Teil davon.

Hinter unserem „wir“ steht dabei ein Kollektiv aus engagierten Persönlichkeiten, was vielseitiger nicht sein könnte. Von ehemaligen Unternehmensberatern renommierter internationaler Unternehmen wie Ernst & Young oder Porsche Consulting über kreative Designprofis und Content-Experten bis zur TikTok Influencerin oder dem studierten Videografen, wir sind in unseren Fähigkeiten unterschiedlich, haben aber doch eine große Gemeinsamkeit: den Anspruch, uns kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und herausragende Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen.

Wenn du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen und gleichermaßen etablierten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs mitzuarbeiten und Teil eines ambitionierten und freundschaftlichen Teams zu werden, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Aufgaben

Dein Part in unserem Team.

In dieser Rolle baust du die technische Seite unseres Tagesgeschäfts weiter aus. Ein großer Teil unserer Arbeit besteht aus wiederkehrenden Abläufen und genau diese Abläufe sollen künftig weitgehend automatisiert laufen. Du triffst dabei auf viel offene Fläche und kurze Entscheidungswege, weil bei uns kein über Jahre gewachsener IT-Altbestand im Weg steht. Perspektivisch entwickelst du Automatisierungen auch für unsere Kunden, überwiegend mittelständische Unternehmen und Kanzleien.

Deine Tätigkeiten im Überblick:

  • Du entwickelst individuelle KI-Lösungen für uns sowie für unsere Kunden

  • Du baust KI-gestützte Workflows, zum Beispiel für Reportings oder für die Erstellung wiederkehrender Dokumente

  • Du entwickelst kleine interne Tools und Skripte, die es so von der Stange nicht gibt

  • Du verbindest unsere bestehenden Systeme miteinander

  • Du prüfst neue Modelle und Tools auf ihren tatsächlichen Nutzen im Alltag und gibst eine klare Empfehlung ab

  • Du dokumentierst deine Automatisierungen so, dass das Team sie auch ohne dich bedienen kann

  • Du schulst unser Team sowie Kunden in der Anwendung automatisierter Prozesse

Qualifikation

Was wir uns von dir wünschen.

Uns interessiert weniger, wie weit du im Studium bist, und mehr, was du schon selbst gebaut hast. Wenn du in deiner Freizeit Dinge automatisierst, weil es dich stört, sie manuell zu machen, passt du gut hierher. Fachlich musst du nicht alles können, du solltest dich aber schnell in unbekannte Tools einarbeiten und ein Problem erst einmal selbst durchdringen, bevor du es weitergibst.

Zusätzlich sind folgende Punkte für die Stelle relevant:

  • Du programmierst sicher, zum Beispiel in Python oder JavaScript, und kommst mit APIs, JSON und Webhooks ohne Anleitung zurecht

  • Du hast bereits Prozesse mit KI automatisiert und dabei mit Umgebungen wie Claude Code, n8n, Make oder vergleichbaren Tools gearbeitet

  • Du verfolgst die Entwicklung bei KI-Modellen und Agenten aus eigenem Interesse

  • Du kannst technische Sachverhalte so erklären, dass Kollegen ohne IT-Hintergrund damit arbeiten können

  • Du kannst unterhalb der Woche deine Arbeitszeit flexibel auf mehrere Tage verteilen

  • Du hast eine gültige Immatrikulationsbescheinigung

Benefits

Warum wir kein normaler Arbeitgeber sind.

Ja, wir fordern einiges von unseren Teammitgliedern, dafür haben wir aber auch einiges zu bieten. Wir vertrauen den Menschen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sich jeder gemäß seinen individuellen Stärken und Schwächen weiterentwickeln kann. Wer hoch hinaus möchte, bekommt früh viel Verantwortung und Entwicklungschancen, wer sich noch unsicher ist, wo es hingehen soll, wird an die Hand genommen und erhält Orientierung. Wir sind keine Chefs, Mitarbeiter und Praktikanten, wir sind ein eingeschworenes Team, das zusammen an einem Strang zieht.

Darüber hinaus kannst du dich bei uns auf die folgenden Punkte freuen:

  • Attraktiver Stundenlohn zwischen 15 € und 17 €, je nach deiner Qualifikation

  • Eigene Projekte statt Zuarbeit: Du übernimmst Automatisierungen von der ersten Analyse bis zum laufenden Betrieb

  • Technische Entscheidungsfreiheit: Welche Tools wir einsetzen, entscheidest du mit, nicht eine IT-Abteilung über dir

  • Lernkurve mit Praxisbezug: Du lernst typische Use-Cases im operativen Alltag

  • Flexibilität im Alltag: Hybrid-Arbeit und eine Planung, die sich mit deinem Studium realistisch kombinieren lässt.

  • Starkes Setup: Moderne Ausstattung, komplett digitalisierte Prozesse und ein Team, das Tempo und Qualität ernst nimmt.

jobs.description_html:
Wir suchen jemanden, der unser Broker- und Distributionsgeschäft auf Amazon verantwortet. Wir verkaufen Marken wie SEVERIN, Ritter Sport und Crane Baby sowie eigene Produkte selbst auf Amazon. Du kümmerst dich um Preise, Bestände, Werbung und die Zusammenarbeit mit den Herstellern. Gearbeitet wird bei uns viel mit KI, vor allem mit Claude Cowork und Claude Code.

REVOIC ist eine Amazon-Agentur in Köln-Ehrenfeld mit 16 Leuten. Den Bereich Broker und Distribution bauen wir aus. Deshalb brauchen wir jemanden mit Erfahrung, der ihn führt und das Team anleitet. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer Stephan Bruns zusammen.

Was die Stelle von anderen unterscheidet

  • Eigener Verkauf: Wir verkaufen die Produkte selbst über eigene Seller-Konten. Du legst Preise und Werbebudgets fest und siehst in den Zahlen, was dabei herauskommt.

  • Mehrere Marken: Du betreust mehrere Marken aus unterschiedlichen Kategorien, zum Beispiel Küchengeräte und Schokolade.

  • Kleine Firma: Wir sind 16 Leute. Entscheidungen besprichst du direkt mit dem Gründer, lange Abstimmungen gibt es nicht.

  • KI im Alltag: Wir nutzen Claude Cowork und Claude Code jeden Tag und mit echten Geschäftsdaten. Auswertungen und Automationen kannst du dir selbst bauen.

  • Eigene Auftritte: Stephan Bruns hat die Bücher „Amazon Advertising“ und „Amazon Marketplace“ geschrieben. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du in unseren Seminaren und im Podcast selbst auftreten.

  • Mitgestalten: Du entscheidest mit, welche Marken wir aufnehmen und wie der Bereich arbeitet.

Aufgaben

  • Arbeiten mit KI: Du nutzt Claude Cowork und Claude Code für deine tägliche Arbeit. Du führst Daten aus Seller Central, AMALYTIX, Perpetua und anderen Tools zusammen und wertest sie damit aus.

  • Automatisieren: Du baust Dashboards und Automationen, zum Beispiel für Reporting, Bestandsplanung, Preisüberwachung und Abrechnung. Ziel ist, dass das Team mehr Marken betreuen kann.

  • Wissen weitergeben: Du zeigst den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, wie sie KI sinnvoll einsetzen.

  • Portfolio und Ergebnis: Du verantwortest Umsatz und Deckungsbeitrag mehrerer Marken, planst das Jahr gemeinsam mit den Herstellern und steuerst jede Woche nach.

  • Preise und Buybox: Du legst Preise, Deals und Aktionen fest und sicherst die Buybox, auch wenn andere Händler dieselben Produkte anbieten.

  • Einkauf und Logistik: Du verantwortest Bestellmengen, Bestände und FBA-Anlieferungen und prüfst vor jeder Zusage, ob sich ein Produkt rechnet.

  • Listings und Content: Du gibst die Richtung für Produktseiten, A+ Content und Brand Stores vor und nimmst die Arbeit des Teams ab.

  • Advertising: Du entwickelst die Werbestrategie je Marke, planst die Budgets über mehrere Marktplätze und optimierst Kampagnen selbst oder gemeinsam mit unserem Ads-Team.

  • Hersteller und Konditionen: Du bist erste Ansprechperson für die Entscheider bei den Marken, präsentierst Zahlen auf Deutsch und Englisch und verhandelst Sortiment und Konditionen.

  • Neue Marken gewinnen: Du führst Erstgespräche mit interessierten Herstellern und bewertest, ob eine Marke zu unserem Modell passt. Du arbeitest an Angeboten mit und verantwortest das Onboarding bis zum ersten Verkauf.

  • Internationalisierung: Du bringst Marken in weitere europäische Länder und klärst dafür Registrierungen und Kennzeichnung (EPR, WEEE).

  • Team: Du leitest die Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Broker-Team an, verteilst Aufgaben, gibst Feedback und arbeitest neue Juniors ein.

  • Sichtbarkeit: Du vertrittst REVOIC nach außen: mit Fachbeiträgen auf LinkedIn, in unserem Podcast und Newsletter, in Seminaren und auf Konferenzen, auch zum Arbeiten mit KI im Amazon-Geschäft.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Verantwortung für ein Markenportfolio oder eine große Marke auf Amazon, mit Umsatz- und Budgetverantwortung. Ob bei einem Händler, einer Marke oder in einer Agentur, ist für uns zweitrangig.

  • Du arbeitest schon mit KI-Werkzeugen und kannst ein Beispiel zeigen, etwa eine eigene Automation oder ein Dashboard. Bei uns sind Claude Cowork und Claude Code Standard. Wer sie noch nicht kennt, arbeitet sich in den ersten Wochen ein.

  • Seller Central in der Tiefe für die europäischen Marktplätze: Lagerbestandsdateien, Varianten, FBA-Anlieferpläne, Kontogesundheit und das Eskalieren schwieriger Fälle beim Amazon-Support

  • Nachweisbare Praxis in Amazon Advertising: eigene Strategien, Budgets über mehrere Marktplätze, Steuerung nach ACoS und TACoS

  • Kaufmännisches Denken: Du kalkulierst mit Amazon-Gebühren, Werbekosten und Retouren und kennst den Deckungsbeitrag deiner Produkte

  • Erfahrung im Führen oder Anleiten von Kolleginnen und Kollegen

  • Sicheres Auftreten vor Geschäftsführung und Vertriebsleitung, in Präsentationen wie in Verhandlungen

  • Erfahrung in der Akquise oder im Onboarding neuer Kunden oder Marken

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift

  • Routine im Umgang mit Daten in Excel oder Google Sheets

Was uns zusätzlich freut

  • Erfahrung mit weiteren Marktplätzen wie OTTO oder Kaufland

  • Eigene Vorträge, Seminare oder Fachbeiträge

  • Erfahrung mit APIs oder MCP-Anbindungen

  • Praxis mit AMALYTIX, Perpetua oder vergleichbaren Tools

Benefits

  • Verantwortung für einen Bereich, den wir ausbauen, und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Claude Cowork und Claude Code ab dem ersten Tag

  • Auftritte in unseren Seminaren, im Podcast, beim REVOIC Roundtable und auf Konferenzen, wenn du das möchtest

  • Weiterbildung zu Amazon und KI

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Büro in Ehrenfeld, flexible Zeiten und Homeoffice-Anteil

  • Deutschlandticket oder Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club

  • Getränke, Obst und reichlich Ritter Sport im Büro

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und gemeinsames Frühstück

So bewirbst du dich

Wichtig: Ohne Video können wir deine Bewerbung nicht berücksichtigen.

Statt eines Anschreibens schickst du uns den Links eines Videos von höchstens 2 Minuten, auf Deutsch, ein Handyvideo reicht. Zwei Fragen solltest du darin beantworten:

  1. Welches Amazon-Geschäft hast du zuletzt verantwortet, und was ist dabei herausgekommen?

  2. Was hast du zuletzt mit KI gebaut oder automatisiert, und warum willst du das bei REVOIC tun?

Den Link zum Video trägst du in der Bewerbung ein, dazu kommt dein Lebenslauf und relevante Zeugnisse. Du hörst innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

The Mission

Publitas turns static, dead PDFs into interactive, shoppable digital content discovery experiences. Across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH), massive retailers and e-commerce brands are sitting on print catalogs that need to move digital.

Your mission as Senior Account Executive is simple: take complete ownership of the DACH territory, aggressively prospect into mid-market and enterprise retail accounts, and turn relationships into closed ARR. We work 80% asynchronously and judge you entirely on pipeline velocity and quota achievement—not on the number of hours you sit on Zoom.

What Success Looks Like (Your First 90 Days)

We don't measure you by years of experience; we measure you by outcomes. Here is what you will achieve in your first 3 months:

  • Day 30: You have completely mastered the Publitas value proposition, understand our core retail/e-commerce personas, and have built a targeted list of your top 50 high-priority DACH accounts.

  • Day 60: You have independently built and launched multichannel outbound sequences. You are running discovery calls completely unassisted and have successfully moved your first self-generated opportunities into the negotiation stage (at least 1).

  • Day 90: Your outbound engine is predictable. You have built an active pipeline worth 3x your quarterly target and closed your first mid-market DACH deal.


The DNA of a Sales Executive at Publitas (Culture & Ownership)

  • Founder-Level Ownership: You treat the DACH territory like your own independent business. You don't wait around for inbound marketing leads, sales enablement decks, or a manager to tell you who to call. You map the territory, identify the decision-makers, and architect the outbound strategies required to break into enterprise accounts from scratch.

  • A Continuous Growth Mindset: Modern B2B sales cycles shift rapidly, and legacy sales scripts no longer work on smart e-commerce buyers. You are constantly experimenting with new outreach mediums, testing messaging hooks, and studying the digital retail landscape. When a deal stalls, you don't blame the product, you treat it as a data point to dissect, learn from, and iterate your approach for the next pitch.

  • High Autonomy, Zero Ego: In a remote-first, asynchronous sales team, there is nowhere to hide behind "busywork" or metrics vanity. You thrive on being judged entirely by your pipeline health and closed ARR. You don't need continuous synchronous cheerleading; your motivation is entirely internal.

What We Offer You to Win

  • Transparent & Uncapped Compensation: A competitive base salary of €60k - €85k (geo-bracketed to your location) + an uncapped Variable Compensation Plan (VCP) where you are rewarded heavily for target overachievement.

  • True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

  • Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

  • Modern Sales Stack & Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

  • Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

  • Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

The Non-Negotiables

  • Native/Fluent German & Professional English: You will be closing deals in German; you will be collaborating with the global team in English.

  • Proven B2B SaaS Closing Record: You have spent at least 3+ years managing full-cycle sales cycles (from cold outreach to signed contract) directly within the DACH retail, e-commerce, or digital marketing spaces.

  • Outbound Execution: You do not wait for inbound marketing leads. You know how to multi-thread accounts and hunt your own pipeline.

  • AI-First Execution: We do not scale headcount to solve manual problems. You must have a proven track record of working in an AI-first way, leveraging generative AI tools to hyper-personalize outbound messaging, automate account research, summarize call data, and accelerate your sales velocity.

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.

Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

Location Details: United States, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

This position is not eligible to be performed in Alaska, Mississippi, North Dakota, or the Virgin Islands.

GoDaddy is not currently considering candidates for this role in California, Seattle, or NYC.

Join our team

GoDaddy is in the middle of a significant product transformation. Roughly two-thirds of our product development work now involves artificial intelligence, and the questions our product teams need answered have changed fundamentally. We're no longer just evaluating interfaces. But the dynamic human-AI systems: whether they're useful, trustworthy, recoverable, and understood by the customers who depend on them.

We are seeking a Director UX Research for the Product Experience group to join our team! Partnering directly with collaborators across business functions, your mandate is twofold. Set and uphold the research standard for user experience professionals conducting generative and iterative research. Support partner teams doing small-batch testing. Additionally, personally lead strategic and AI evaluation work that demands dedicated research depth.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a research queue. It's for a leader who sees research as both a customer intelligence capability and a product quality system and who knows how to operate both at the speed modern product development demands. GoDaddy's UX designers are capable practitioners who handle a significant volume of discovery and evaluative research. The research team's value is highest where that work can't go: complex AI experience evaluation, cross-product synthesis, foundational understanding of customer behavior, and the strategic questions that require dedicated depth!

What you'll get to do...

Research Strategy and Prioritization

  • Define a research agenda that sits ahead of product roadmaps, not behind them — identifying the questions that need to be answered before key product and architectural decisions are made
  • Partner with Product, Build, and senior Engineering management to align research priorities against product risk, customer impact, and AI complexity
  • Distinguish between what the research team should own directly and what the broader UX community can handle with the right support
  • Help GoDaddy continue to mature in how it uses AI to test, validate, and accelerate insight generation — developing a point of view on where AI-assisted methods are appropriate and where human judgment remains essential
  • Represent research as a key influence on product direction, not a validation step after building

AI Evaluation and Emerging Experience Research

  • Lead research into the human dimensions of GoDaddy's AI products: how customers understand, trust, accurately address, adapt to, and recover from experiences involving artificial intelligence
  • Partner on evaluation frameworks for agentic and AI-assisted features — contributing methodological expertise on trust, control, edge cases, and live-product monitoring — before and after launch
  • Bring leadership to research questions that don't have established playbooks: prompt and workflow analysis, human-in-the-loop testing, behavioral data interpretation in AI contexts
  • Stay current on AI-experience research methods and bring that knowledge into the team and the wider build group

Standards, Enablement, and Research Craft

  • Set the research quality bar for the entire Product UX organization. This includes UX designers conducting generative and iterative research, as well as partner teams running their own small-batch testing.
  • Refine existing frameworks, guardrails, and playbooks so that designers and partner teams can run clean discovery: when directional research is enough, when it isn't, how to synthesize and share findings, so they compound across the org
  • Lead all aspects of the continued development of UX designers running research — building research craft, raising quality standards, and driving the integration of AI research tools and methodologies into how the broader design organization works
  • Ensure shared infrastructure remains current and usable: repositories, taxonomies, participant panels, consent and data governance standards, AI-assisted workflows

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a research team that includes both existing researchers and new hires
  • Build toward complementary strengths across the team: generative and assessment-focused research, quantitative and mixed-methods capability, AI evaluation proficiency, and research operations
  • Mentor UX researchers directly on craft, career development, and the evolving demands of researching technology-enhanced product experiences
  • Build a culture where rigor and velocity are treated as compatible, not competing, where "directional and fast" and "deep and strategic" are both valued depending on the decision at stake

Cross-Functional and Organizational Influence

  • Operate as a peer to the Design, Product, and Engineering leaders — shaping product strategy, not just informing it
  • Partner with different departments to ensure research is connected to commercial priorities, not siloed within the build organization
  • Build organizational confidence that product decisions are grounded in real customer understanding, particularly as AI capabilities expand faster than product intuition can track

Your experience should include...

  • 10+ years of UX or user research experience, with demonstrated proficiency in mixed-methods approaches
  • 4+ years leading research teams, with direct responsibility for hiring, mentoring, and performance development
  • Meaningful experience researching AI-driven, technically complex, or developer-facing products
  • Track record of refining and operationalizing research standards, frameworks, or enablement tools that extended research quality beyond the immediate research team
  • Experience operating as a strategic partner to Product and Engineering leadership, not just delivering studies but shaping direction
  • Experience partnering with various departments beyond just a build or product organization

You might also have...

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, SMB products, or multi-product platforms where research prioritization across a large portfolio was a core challenge
  • Familiarity with research operations at scale: participant recruiting infrastructure, insight repositories, governance frameworks
  • Proficiency working with behavioral data, product analytics, or telemetry alongside qualitative findings
  • Background in human-computer interaction, cognitive psychology, behavioral science, or related fields

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

jobs.description_html:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As the Principal Product Manager, Network Economics at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is looking for a principal-level individual contributor to own therapist compensation and incentives: the economic mechanisms that determine whether a client who needs care can find the right therapist, in their state, under their plan, as soon as possible. We match hundreds of thousands of clients to licensed therapists across every state and a growing set of insurance plans. How quickly that match happens comes down to the strength, size, and variety of our therapist population, and how quickly we can shift it toward the plans and states where clients are waiting.

This individual will own the mechanisms that drive that supply pool, compensation rates, structure, and incentives, as a product and be accountable for the business outcome, not just the shipped feature. That means close collaboration with cross functional stakeholders, deriving defensible answers to how much therapist capacity we actually need and where, and experiments that tell us how the network responds when we change what it earns.

It’s an exciting opportunity for someone who is deeply analytical and does their best work in ambiguity: able to take a problem where the data is incomplete and the stakeholders don’t yet agree, and still reach an effective outcome with the organization behind it. The problems here sit where product, economics, and clinical operations meet, all while making a difference in the lives of people seeking mental health care.

What will you do?

  • Own the incentive system that moves therapist availability toward where clients actually need it, designed to be targeted, measurable, and reversible
  • Own the structure and clarity of the compensation model itself: what a therapist can predict about their earnings, and what the model rewards them for
  • Define what “well supplied” means for a network like ours, and build the tools and features that close the gap
  • Build a compelling and sustainable earnings proposition for therapists, and use controlled rollouts and rigorous measurement to learn what actually moves availability before we commit to it, all within the realities of a licensed, independent clinical workforce
  • Incentivize the specific behaviors that create client access, including therapist availability, match acceptance, and continuity of care
  • Analyze and quantify the impact of every change we make, then draw conclusions and plan next steps based on actual data
  • Partner closely with matching, eligibility, member experience, therapist experience, and provider acquisition. Your systems and theirs depend on each other
  • Work cross-functionally with finance, clinical, legal, marketing, data science, and operations, who have a stake in nearly everything this role touches, to get a change designed, approved, launched, and measured
  • Participate in setting the strategy and long-term direction for the organization, both within and beyond the context of product
  • Own KPI’s and be obsessed about them
  • In a nutshell: Diagnose, model, design, test, measure, decide, systematize

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Requirements

  • 8-10 years experience in a product role with proven success through measurable impact and increasing responsibilities, including experience owning pricing, incentives, payouts, or supply-side economics in a two-sided marketplace
  • Super analytical: you can build the model, defend it in a room with data science, and explain it to a CFO without losing either audience
  • Deep understanding of unit and business economics, and a proven ability to balance business, clinical, and technical considerations in a product decision
  • You know which decisions to test cheaply and which ones you only get to make once, and you can tell the difference under time pressure
  • Strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and two-sided marketplace business models
  • Sound judgment in ambiguity. You can tell when the evidence is good enough to act on and when the right move is to dig deeper, and you can explain which call you’re making and why
  • A track record of driving cross-functional decisions to a conclusion without authority over the people who have to agree
  • Excellent written communication. Much of this role is making a quantitative argument that an executive audience can act on
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills, strong attention to detail, able to work independently

Bonus (Great to have, but not required):

  • Experience with supply-side economics in a marketplace where supply is labor: ride-hail, delivery, or a professional services marketplace
  • Experience compensating an independent contractor workforce, and familiarity with the constraints that come with it
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, or another business where eligibility and payer rules shape who can serve whom
  • Fluency with experimentation and causal inference where clean randomization isn’t always available

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

We only post open roles on our career page (betterhelp.com/careers) or reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages, and all official BetterHelp recruitment emails will come from the domain @betterhelp.com. Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more. As businesses continue to shift to a real-time, customer-centric communications model, we are experiencing a time of impressive growth.

Why this role matters

Platform engineering sits at the heart of how software gets built at scale, and this team will help define how Vonage works. You will lead a group of engineers who are directly responsible for the platforms, workflows, and automation that the wider engineering organisation depends on every day. The organisation is going through a meaningful platform evolution: modernising tooling, raising the automation ceiling, and standardising how engineering teams ship software at scale. There is real work to do, real complexity to navigate, and a real mandate to make things better. This is a role for an engineering manager who wants to lead through change as Vonage continues to drive innovation. You will lead a globally distributed engineering team focused on growing engineers and delivering in a complex, high-stakes environment where your work is felt every day.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to write and review production code, contribute to architecture decisions, and participate directly in the on-call rotation — not only manage others who do those things.

Your key responsibilities

  • Lead the EU/US Platform Engineering team – Provide day-to-day people management and technical leadership for a geographically distributed team of platform engineers.

  • Stay hands-on technically – Write and review production code, contribute to technical and architecture decisions, and work directly with the team on complex engineering challenges.

  • Drive the roadmap forward – Execute the roadmap under the direction of the Director of Engineering and Product Owner, ensuring deliverables are not blocked by external dependencies.

  • Develop your people – Team members are transitioning from SRE/infrastructure backgrounds into platform product engineering; you will coach and grow them toward ownership, customer-first thinking, and modern platform development practices.

  • Coordinate large-scale cross-team changes – Own the coordination of platform-wide changes such as Kubernetes upgrades, tooling migrations, and security hardening that touch many teams and require alignment across multiple stakeholders and time zones.

  • Operate within compliance and security constraints – Ensure all platform work meets security and regulatory requirements while maintaining appropriate guardrails and policies.

  • Be data-driven – Establish and track SLAs, error budgets, KPIs, and change failure rates; use metrics to prioritise work, communicate platform health to stakeholders, and continuously improve the team's delivery velocity.

  • Maintain platform reliability – Participate directly in the on-call rotation with your team and set the standard for operational excellence, incident response, and production ownership.

  • Partner with architects and product – Work closely with the Chief Architect (US-based), Director of Engineering, and Product Owner on platform direction, architecture, and prioritisation.

What you'll bring

Required

  • 2+ years of engineering management experience leading platform, DevOps, or SRE teams.

  • A strong hands-on engineering background before moving into management – You have personally written and shipped production code, owned systems end-to-end, and debugged production issues.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes-based platforms (EKS preferred), including cluster lifecycle management, upgrades at scale, operational troubleshooting, and cross-team rollout coordination.

  • Strong hands-on experience with the AWS ecosystem and a solid understanding of how AWS services underpin enterprise platform infrastructure.

  • Proven ability to lead and grow engineers through skill transitions, especially from operational/SRE roles into product-oriented platform engineering.

  • A genuine dependency-unblocking mindset – You know how to drive cross-team commitments, escalate constructively, and keep complex multi-team deliverables on track.

  • A data-driven approach to platform management – You are comfortable defining and tracking SLAs, KPIs, change failure rates, and error budgets.

  • Familiarity with compliance and security constraints in a regulated environment – You do not treat them as blockers but as guardrails to engineer around.

  • Strong leadership instincts – You set a high bar, give clear feedback, and build psychological safety.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Port.io, OpsLevel, or a similar Internal Developer Platform product.

  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD, Crossplane, or Kyverno.

  • AWS and/or Kubernetes certifications.

  • Experience in CFIUS-regulated or similarly complex compliance environments.

  • Multisport Gym Membership

  • Lunch and Learn Sessions held monthly

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the cornerstone of technical customer success. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.

This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization: Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.
  • Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience: Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.
  • Execute Transformational Technical Account Management: Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.
  • Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise: Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.
  • Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning: Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.
  • Communicate with Influence and Clarity: Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.
  • Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.
  • Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier: Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.
  • Embody Samsara's Values & Principles: Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Experience: 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success.
  • Education: We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Technical Proficiency: Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.
  • Bilingual: English and Spanish is a must.
  • Customer Focus: A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.
  • Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.
  • Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us.   • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work during Pacific time zone business hours.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

The role:

We are looking for a BizOps Associate/ Analyst, passionate about the startup world, hungry to learn from multiple functions and areas, with growth projections in one of the most competitive industries and markets in the world.

You will play a crucial role to drive forward the company’s most impactful initiatives. This will be a great fit if you want to make an impact on the business. You’ll perform as an internal consultant that will help management to set goals and achieve them.

Areas of operations are wide and may include: Strategy, Planning, Operations, Finance, Business, Technology, Marketing, Org Design.

Responsibilities:

As part of the BizOps team, you’ll be joining a strategy-focused group that drives high-impact projects across the company. Within BizOps, the Chef Marketing area is dedicated to building tools and programs that help chefs grow their volume on the CookUnity platform.

  • Own the execution of Chef Marketing initiatives: Take ownership of measuring the impact of each initiative — from tracking performance to calculating how much volume each chef drove and determining the amount to be charged.
  • Contribute to initiative design: Participate in the brainstorming and development of new Chef Marketing tools and programs.
  • Identify growth opportunities: Analyze chef performance metrics to uncover opportunities that can increase chef competitiveness.
  • OKR tracking: Monitor and support company-level OKRs
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with other teams (Growth, Analytics, Product, Brand, Chef Ops) to advance strategic projects with company-wide impact.
  • Insights & reporting: Build and maintain reports/dashboards to track performance of Chef Marketing initiatives.
  • Ad hoc support: Assist in research, presentations, and documentation for strategic projects led by BizOps leadership.

Qualifications:

  • 1-2 year of experience in aspects/concepts cross to an ORG: value proposition, strategy, funding, technology, ops, branding, GTM, or building high-functioning leadership teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills paired with the ability to develop creative and efficient solutions
  • Corporate finance knowledge to create high-level business cases to prioritize and estimate the impact of multiple initiatives/solutions across the company
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and effectively with people at all levels in an organization
  • Consulting experience is a plus
  • Advanced level of English

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Benefits

💸 Get paid in USD.

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical

🐣 Paid Family leave

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises

🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

Customer Success Management at Expensify

Own a portfolio of our mid-market and enterprise customers, from onboarding through renewal and growth. You'll be the person enterprise customers trust to keep things running, and to spot the next opportunity before they've even asked. If you like turning usage data into revenue outcomes and holding your own in a C-suite conversation, this one's for you.

 

As a Customer Success Manager, your responsibilities include:

  • Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across finance, IT and operations, right up to the C-suite

  • Owning the full account lifecycle, from onboarding through adoption, renewal and growth

  • Spotting risk and configuration issues early, and proactively solving them

  • Guiding customers through migrations and product rollouts, instilling confidence in the product and your ability to support them in any software transition within their tech stack
